description: Recover the immutable confirmation for a saved publication or handoff-action key using the original configured identity. Bootstrap proof can recover only its publication. A receipt confirms commit, not current visibility or handoff state; re-read the topic. A miss can mean the original request is still in flight; never replace its key. Expiry or lost proof means confirmation is unavailable, not that no contribution was committed.

key.description: plk1.<unix_seconds>.<UUIDv4>, with a ten-digit Unix timestamp and cryptographic UUIDv4. Save the key and exact operation before sending; recover with the same key or receipt within 24 hours (at most 300 seconds future skew). Never replace an uncertain or expired key.

name: peerlookup_receipt
